native.ktp_profile: Actual reviewed TP implementation: TI overview does not qualify a chip or full standard.
native.ktp_role: Actual endpoint/repeater/line-area coupler/monitor; each segment and other medium independent.
native.ktp_frame_kind: Actual standard versus extended data versus ACK versus polling; distinct lengths/bit slots.
native.ktp_host_kind: Actual selected PHY-host link, not the9600bit/s TP line.
native.ktp_host_parity: Actual host UART parity, separate from TP per-character even parity.
native.ktp_host_order: Actual PHY-host bit order, distinct from address byte order.
native.ktp_host_frame_end: Actual NCN host silence versus escaped marker framing.
native.ktp_spi_master: Actual clock owner on the PHY-host link; NCN5120 is SPI master.
native.ktp_device_state: Actual NCN state; NORMAL alone allows TP communication.
native.ktp_address_kind: Actual individual versus group versus broadcast destination.
native.ktp_group_edition: Actual legacy15bit overview versus pinned/current qualified16bit group layout.
native.ktp_group_style: Actual raw/two/three-level view of same group address.
native.ktp_power_basis: Actual measured/datasheet load versus explicitly estimated ETS fallback.
native.ktp_cable_profile: Actual approved0.8mm TP cable versus separately qualified realization.
native.ktp_ack_kind: Actual observed positive ACK/NACK/BUSY/no response; no default positive acknowledgment.
native.ktp_revision: Actual full selected KNX TP1 link/application/security edition, not generic CAN parameters.
native.ktp_device_source: Actual chip/board/firmware capabilities and qualified standard/extended frames.
native.ktp_binding_source: Actual canonical independent TP port/segment; hostUART/SPI or couplerIP/RF has its own registered path.
native.ktp_commissioning_source: Actual ETS physical/group address/filter/object/DPT configuration; no zero-address placeholder.
native.ktp_application_source: Actual DPT/APCI/TPCI/application codec and bytes;ACK is not execution completion.
native.ktp_encoding_source: Actual standard/extended telegram,per-byte parity/odd column check;not RF FT3 CRC.
native.ktp_schedule_source: Actual shared TP contention,priority,byte pauses,repetitions/ACK/polling and all traffic.
native.ktp_capacity_source: Actual TP capacity plus independently sized UART/SPI/coupler paths and approved load.
native.ktp_acceptance_source: Actual functional E2E/freshness/safety distinct from positive local L_Data.con.
native.ktp_host_source: Actual selected PHY-host baudrate,UART/SPI mode/owner/frame buffer/service/escaping.
native.ktp_host_buffer_source: Actual implementation send-offset/frame buffer limits and extended-frame acceptance.
native.ktp_address_source: Actual selected edition-specific group layout/allocated address and coupler filters.
native.ktp_power_source: Actual approved PSU/voltage/current derating/all device loads; ETS estimates remain estimates.
native.ktp_checksum_source: Actual complete wire bytes/odd column check and parity decoding, no invented checksum.
native.ktp_coupler_source: Actual filtering/hop/repeater rules,translation and independently qualified other medium.
native.ktp_polling_source: Actual polling master/slave slots/state and service codec, not regular dataframe.
native.ktp_registered_profile_source: Actual alternate registered TP/host/service schema,implementation and test proof.
native.ktp_security_source: Actual Data Secure endpoint/group commissioning and protected keys, no IP Secure copy.
native.ktp_group_key_ref: Actual protected Data Secure group key reference,not secret/defaultkey.
native.ktp_bitrate_bps: TP1 information rate9600bit/s,independent of hostSPI/UART clock.
native.ktp_idle_bits: Actual initial free medium wait at least50TP bitperiods;5.2ms overviewrounded.
native.ktp_idle_ms: Actual free medium wait converted from exact9600bit/s,not rounded5.2ms equality.
native.ktp_active_pulse_us: Actual qualified active-zero pulse,overview35us nominal not full tolerance proof.
native.ktp_equalization_us: Actual qualified equalization pulse,overview69us rounded nominal.
native.ktp_pulse_drop_v: Actual active voltage drop,overviewapproximately6..9V; requires measured PHY evidence.
native.ktp_supply_nominal_v: Actual approvedPSU nominal voltage,association29V proposal not measurednodevoltage.
native.ktp_bus_voltage_v: Actual local devicebusvoltage under load and signaltransients.
native.ktp_device_min_v: Actual selecteddevice voltage minimum,not universalTI20vsassociation21V assumption.
native.ktp_supply_current_ma: Actual qualified availablecurrent or explicitly estimatedETS320mA,not universal640mA.
native.ktp_segment_load_ma: Actual sum of all device/coupler current on this segment,not one device*guessedcount.
native.ktp_repeated: Actual retransmission state used to decode invertedrepeatbit.
